summary: Defines internationalized domain names and the IDNA mechanism, which lets domain names use non-ASCII characters from Unicode while representing them using ASCII so existing DNS software keeps working. It was replaced by RFC 5890 and RFC 5891.

eli5.summary: Web addresses used to be limited to plain English letters. IDNA lets people use their own alphabets by quietly converting them to a plain form. It was later replaced by RFC 5890 and RFC 5891.
